I'm badly outmatched here—p2 has $1219 with three built-up monopolies while I'm sitting on $214 with weaker pinks, and I just landed on a mortgaged Mediterranean with no rent due. I'm weighing whether to add houses to my pinks or mortgage properties like the railroads and Ventnor/North Carolina to raise cash, knowing a hit on Boardwalk with three houses could cost me $1400 and essentially end my game.

My bigger worry is that my next rolls could land me on p2's light blues (Oriental, Vermont, Connecticut), which would cost $270-300 and wipe me out, so I need roughly $300 in reserve just to survive. Trading away single properties like Ventnor or North Carolina would only hand p2 another monopoly, so my best bet right now is hoarding cash rather than building, just to weather the likely light blue hit.

With that liquidity, light blue hits are survivable but Boardwalk isn't regardless. Pushing to 3 houses would need mortgaging everything, leaving barely any cash cushion beyond selling houses back at half price — risky, but given how far behind I am, it might be the gamble worth taking since p2's odds of landing on pinks each lap are meaningful.

Let me go moderate instead: mortgage Ventnor and North Carolina, build both up to 2 houses, doing one call at a time starting with mortgaging Ventnor.
